positions.as_written: Assess the effusion's size and tension, since a tense effusion is the characteristic finding.
Assess the range, which will be limited by the tension, and record that the effusion was present when it was measured.
Examine the ligaments, accepting that the examination is less reliable in this setting and that guarding produces false reassurance.
Examine for a patellar dislocation: medial retinacular tenderness, apprehension and a palpable defect.
